newsitem.title: CHINA: China Intrbank Market rates (CHIBOR) close.
newsitem.headline: China Intrbank Market rates (CHIBOR) close.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said selling by some banks continued but was weaker than last week.
"Buying mainly came from some coastal short-term financial centres such as Hainan, Shenzhen and Jiangsu," one local trader said.
With domestic inflation rates falling, the CHIBOR will go down in the longer term if the central bank cuts interest rates early next year as some analysts expect, local traders said.
"But in the short time, the rates are likely to stay at the current levels due to a balance between buying and selling forces," another trader said.
